hook_text: Cut a cereal box open and press it flat. What shape do you get?
clip_script: Rustenburg, a recycling project. Boxes, tins, a ball, a cone-shaped funnel. Flat or curved? The box has 6 flat faces. The tin has 2 circle faces and 1 curved surface. The ball has no flat faces at all. Toothpaste box and pyramid: both 5 faces, but not the same shapes. Now cut the cereal box open and press it flat: a net of 6 rectangles in 3 pairs. A cube net? 6 squares in a cross. But a row of 6 squares will not fold into a cube. Try it.
visual_style: A box being cut along its edges and unfolding flat, then a cross of squares folding into a cube.
mood: Hands-on and satisfying, like a craft project coming together.
pacing: Quick sort, the 5-face surprise, then a slow unfold and fold.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and cut open a box at home to find its net.
